iWant: the pages Squire makes for me visible on my Mac only
soThat: nobody else on my network or the internet can see them
description: Pages, the home dashboard and voice-note pages are all served by the one page server on the Mac.
title: Pages on the Mac only

acceptanceCriteria.description: The pages Squire makes can be seen on the Squire owner's Mac only.
acceptanceCriteria.when: A page, the dashboard or the comment post is requested from the Mac with the link's current secret, without it, or with a secret from before the page server last started, and from another machine
acceptanceCriteria.then: A request from the Mac with the link's current secret succeeds; another machine cannot connect; a request without it, or with an earlier one, is refused, the comment post included.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every page Squire serves is shown in Squire's default theme, in light and in dark, or in the Squire owner's own theme when they have put one in their Squire folder.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire's page server running, with or without a theme file of the Squire owner's own in their Squire folder
acceptanceCriteria.when: A page Squire made, a Markdown page or the home dashboard is opened on the Mac
acceptanceCriteria.then: every page Squire serves, the dashboard included, is shown in Squire's default theme, in light and in dark; a Markdown page is shown formatted, never as raw marks; when the owner has put a theme file of their own in their Squire folder, pages use it in place of the default.
